message:
Per #1847: apply review notes for command-line output rendering

Applies the follow-up called out in #1847 and the corresponding reviewer LGTM on the command-line plugin cleanup.

This is not introducing a new approach; it is the mechanical implementation of the previously approved direction to keep `data-output` / filtered output lines flowing through the same raw rendering path they used before the prompt-wrapper refactor, so output text remains consistent with existing command-line examples and snapshots.

What changed:
- restores direct insertion of captured output lines in `before-insert`
- keeps command lines wrapped exactly as they are today
- updates the minified plugin to match the source change

Why this is being applied:
- the review notes on #1847 were to preserve legacy output rendering behavior for the command-line plugin rather than alter displayed output semantics as part of that refactor
- a few downstream examples depend on output lines rendering verbatim, so this follow-up aligns HEAD with that already-approved decision

Given that the rendering direction was already signed off in #1847, this PR is intentionally scoped to applying that decision in source + minified artifacts, not re-litigating the behavior change itself.
